answer: Kiran changes from treating Biscuit as a problem to fix to treating her as a friend he keeps company. On Monday he tries to coax her out from under the bed, for example with the feather toy [2]. This shows he is trying to make her do something. By Wednesday evening, "Biscuit sat beside him, staring at the page as if she were checking his work" [6].
